DATA USE AGREEMENT FOR A LIMITED DATA SET

This Data Use Agreement is entered into as of March 9, 2026 between Halcyon Regional Medical Center ("Covered Entity") and Brannock Institute ("Recipient").

1. Limited Data Set. Covered Entity will send Recipient a limited data set, as described in 45 C.F.R. § 164.514(e), drawn from its emergency department records for 2024.

2. Cooperation. Recipient will tell Covered Entity which data fields it needs, and Covered Entity will deliver the limited data set by secure file transfer.

3. Publication. Recipient will give Covered Entity a copy of any article based on the limited data set at least 30 days before submitting it.

4. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Indiana.

HALCYON REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER
